title: Claude Design: Prototype and UI Generation with Opus 4.7
summary: Specialized interface for generating high-fidelity UI/UX prototypes and professional presentation layouts using the Claude Opus 4.7 model. It supports high-resolution image analysis and adaptive reasoning to ensure pixel-accurate design execution.
research_notes: Features 3.75-megapixel vision support and achieved 87.6% on SWE-bench Verified.

evolution.summary: The product remains the flagship design tool in the Anthropic Labs suite, recently gaining deep integration with automated coding workflows via GitHub webhooks. It is part of the broader Claude 4 series which transitioned to an adaptive thinking architecture.
